params.method: estimateEdgeRates (dem.js, DECISIONS E3); classes clamped to [1e-5, 0.5)

R_bright_per_us.source: Crain et al., Commun. Phys. 2, 97 (2019), 171Yb+ with SNSPD, Results (Fig. 2a discussion): overall photon detection rate 472(14) kcps = 0.472 counts/us (collected, system efficiency 4.356%)

R_dark_per_us.source: Crain et al., Commun. Phys. 2, 97 (2019), Results and Methods: background count rate 4.2(1) cps = 4.2e-6 counts/us

gamma_bright_to_dark_per_us.source: Crain et al., Commun. Phys. 2, 97 (2019), Results (Fig. 2a discussion): dark pumping rate 341(13) Hz = 3.41e-4 /us

gamma_dark_to_bright_per_us.source: Crain et al., Commun. Phys. 2, 97 (2019), Results (Fig. 2a discussion): bright pumping rate 16.4(5) Hz = 1.64e-5 /us

T1_idle_us.source: Microsoft Azure Quantum IonQ provider documentation (learn.microsoft.com/azure/quantum/provider-ionq), IonQ Aria, System timing: T1 10-100 s (same 171Yb+ qubit as Forte; no Forte T1 is published there); lower end 10 s = 1e7 us used (conservative)

tau_grid_us.source: spans the published detection-time range: 10.5-181.6 us (Noek et al., Opt. Lett. 38, 4735 (2013)), 11 us average and 500 us fixed window (Crain et al. 2019); 1-7 us added to resolve the short-time, photon-starved regime

chi_over_2pi_MHz.source: representative transmon value (plan section 7.4 default), not one device; published dispersive shifts span ~0.5-8 MHz, e.g. |chi|/2pi = 7.9 MHz in Walter et al., Phys. Rev. Applied 7, 054020 (2017), arXiv:1701.06933

kappa_over_2pi_MHz.source: chosen as kappa = 2 chi, the optimum of kappa |delta alpha|^2 at fixed nbar (plan section 7); Walter et al., Phys. Rev. Applied 7, 054020 (2017) use the same design rule with a Purcell filter, kappa_eff/2pi = 37.5 MHz

nbar.source: UNSOURCED (illustrative): a few photons, below typical critical photon numbers; plan section 7.4 default

eta.source: representative heterodyne chain with a quantum-limited amplifier (plan section 7.4 default); Walter et al., Phys. Rev. Applied 7, 054020 (2017) report eta = 0.66 with a phase-sensitive parametric amplifier, so 0.3 is conservative

T1_us.source: representative transmon T1 (plan section 7.4 default), within the published range from 7.6 us (Walter et al., Phys. Rev. Applied 7, 054020 (2017)) to a few hundred us in current devices

tau_grid_us.source: spans published integration times: 48-88 ns (Walter et al. 2017) up to the few-us regime where T1 decay dominates

params.ratioXoverZ: bulk detector firing rate (estimatePGate rate) X over Z; delta-method interval on ln ratio, detectors treated as independent

provenance.seedRule: decoderComparison seed = 5000000 + 100000*armIndex + 10000*xIndex + 100*d + 10*logical + draw (hard and soft, naive and learned share it); outOfSample seed = 5900000 + 100*d + 10*r + testedLogical (both decoders share it)
